report_findings: Cardiothoracic ratio normal at 48%. Normal vascularity. Clear lung fields bilaterally without focal consolidation, pneumothorax, or pleural effusion. Osseous thoracic cage intact.

Left ventricular ejection fraction preserved at 58%. Mild concentric left ventricular hypertrophy. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction.
impression: Hypertensive heart remodeling with preserved systolic function.

report_findings: Right kidney measures 9.8 cm, left measures 10.1 cm. Increased bilateral cortical echogenicity consistent with medical renal disease. No hydronephrosis or renal calculi.
impression: Bilateral renal parenchymal disease consistent with clinical CKD.
